_doc: Single source of truth for generated art. Used by tools/sd_local.py (diffusers, no server) and mirrors the style used by tools/sd_export.py (A1111 API). Edit a subject or seed, then regenerate that id with --only. Per asset: optional 'style' (replaces style_suffix) and 'negative_extra'.
style_suffix: dark gothic oil painting, folk horror, dramatic candlelight, deep black shadows, muted earthy colors, painterly brushstrokes, game art
negative_prompt: photograph, portrait photography, white background, sketch, pen drawing, lineart, signature, watermark, text, logo, photo, photorealistic, 3d render, anime, cartoon, blurry, lowres, deformed face, extra limbs, extra fingers, frame, border

sprites._doc: Battle-stage sprites, generated by tools/sd_sprites.py into assets/sprites/<id>/<state>.png (transparent). idle comes from text; other states are img2img from idle so the character keeps its look.

reference._doc: IP-Adapter image prompt: each sprite is conditioned on the character's portrait so it looks like it (owner rule).

weapon_guide._doc: Scribble ControlNet: the weapon drawn as a simple shape from the hands toward the enemy (right), so the model can't leave it hanging. Per character: weapon_shape {kind: line|loop|cross|box|bowl|none, angle, length, width}.

sprites.style: dark gothic oil painting, folk horror, rim lighting, muted earthy colors, painterly
sprites.negative: jungle, plants, foliage, trees, building, scenery, room, multiple characters, duplicate, candle, fire, cropped, close-up, sketch, signature, text, watermark, photo, 3d render, anime, blurry, lowres, deformed face, extra limbs, extra fingers
sprites._negative_doc: Sprites use this full negative instead of negative_extra + the global negative (keeps it under CLIP's 77 tokens).
sprites.negative_extra: candle, candles, fire, shrine, altar, cropped, close-up, portrait, scenery, landscape, room, multiple characters, crowd, duplicate

sheet._doc: Humanoids: all states in one image so outfit and weapon match. Cells in state order, left to right, top to bottom.
sheet.prompt_template: character sheet, {look}, six poses, same clothes and {weapon} in each, full body, plain flat grey background, {style}
sheet._redo_doc: States redrawn as one full-size figure after the sheet (cells are too small for a raised weapon).

states.pose: standing in a ready fighting stance
lunging forward and striking with {weapon}, dynamic attack
states.beast_pose: lunging forward to attack with {weapon}, dynamic attack
states.redo_pose: facing left, violent lunge, right arm raising {weapon} toward the left, snarling

states.pose: casting a spell, arm raised high with glowing light
states.beast_pose: howling with glowing eyes, eerie light

states.pose: recoiling in pain, flinching backward, wounded
hunched over in pain, trembling, sickly and afraid
lying dead on the ground, collapsed body
states.beast_pose: lying dead on its side on the ground

sprites._skeleton_doc: OpenPose COCO-18 keypoints as [x, y] fractions of the canvas, order: nose, neck, r_shoulder, r_elbow, r_wrist, l_shoulder, l_elbow, l_wrist, r_hip, r_knee, r_ankle, l_hip, l_knee, l_ankle, r_eye, l_eye, r_ear, l_ear. Humanoid characters follow these poses; beasts use plain img2img.

skeletons._attack_doc: Attack (owner 2026-11-08): heroes stand on the RIGHT of the stage and face LEFT. Violent lunge toward the enemy; their RIGHT arm (keypoints 2-4) is on the enemy side and raises the weapon 45 degrees up-left; left arm back. The model raises the arm on the enemy side of the picture, which facing left is the right arm.
